jamie_support: Customer ticket #98721 - after their IdP cert rotation yesterday (05:12 UTC) our SAML assertions started failing with 403 on ACS. They say it worked before rotation.

priya_se: Can you paste the assertion error/log from our auth service? Any SAML debug detail?

jamie_support: From prod logs:
`SAMLResponse validation failed: X509Certificate chain validation error: unable to get local issuer certificate`

marco_oncall: That reads like an incomplete cert chain being served by the IdP or an edge stripping intermediates. Is the IdP behind a CDN/proxy?

jamie_support: Yes — customer runs idp.example-corp.com behind a reverse proxy layer + CDN. They said they rotated just the leaf and uploaded the chain, but timestamp suggests a stale edge cache may be answering.

lena_sre: Quick repro steps I want us to try: 1) fetch metadata XML 2) curl the metadata endpoint with -vk 3) openssl s_client -showcerts to see chain. Jamie, can you run those and paste outputs?

jamie_support: Running now: `curl -vk https://idp.example-corp.com/metadata` -> TLS handshake ok but metadata XML contains `<KeyDescriptor use="signing">...<X509Certificate>MIIB...==</X509Certificate>...</KeyDescriptor>` (only leaf cert).

jamie_support: `openssl s_client -showcerts -connect idp.example-corp.com:443` shows a single cert from server, no intermediate(s) in the chain.

priya_se: That matches the log. Our SAML verifier expects the full signing cert chain to validate signature against the trust store. If intermediate missing, chain validation fails.

marco_oncall: Likely root cause: IdP upload skipped intermediate, or CDN terminated TLS and didn't pass intermediates. Two remediation paths: 1) Ask IdP admin to upload full bundle (leaf + intermediates) into their server/edge. 2) If CDN strips, have them configure origin to include full chain and purge edge caches.

jamie_support: I asked the customer to re-upload full bundle and to purge CDN. They purged; I triggered our test.

deploy_bot: cdn-purge job started by jamie_support for idp.example-corp.com - job id cp-2026-04-11-19

jamie_support: After purge, `openssl s_client -showcerts` now returns leaf + intermediate (2 certs). Retesting SAML flow...

jamie_support: Success — assertion validated, ACS returned 200. Customer reports SSO now works. :tada:

lena_sre: Great. Follow-ups: - Add a KB reply template explaining that IdP must serve full TLS chain and SAML metadata must include full signing certificate if using embedded certs. - Recommend checking CDN edge TTLs on cert rotation.

priya_se: I'll open an internal doc for common cert-rotation checklist for SSO customers (include commands we used: curl -vk, openssl s_client -showcerts, inspect metadata for X509Certificate count).

marco_oncall: If customer had been on Dedicated infra we might mitigate with our proxy caching layer — flagging eng-infra to evaluate a future heuristic to detect missing chain in metadata and surface a warning in console. Filing ENGINFRA-412.

jamie_support: Marking ticket resolved, leaving notes in support ticket about required steps and our repro commands. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
